resources.string: Trailscape tells you what to ride today — and builds you a matching loop over gravel and quiet lanes that ends where it starts.
In a moment you’ll find Today, Map, History and Training at the bottom, next to the round Ride button. Everything else is behind the gear.
Your data stays on your device. No account, no telemetry.
With your past rides, the analysis is meaningful straight away — without them it takes about two weeks.
GPX, FIT or complete exports from Strava, Garmin and Wahoo as a ZIP. Trailscape spots duplicates by itself.
Import via the + at the top right of History — or share a file straight to Trailscape.
A few details for the analysis
From your age and weight, Trailscape estimates heart rate and power — the basis of all training load.
You can also leave this empty. Enter more precise values later under Settings → Profile.
If your watch writes to Health Connect (Samsung Health, Garmin, Fitbit and others), resting heart rate, HRV and sleep feed into the daily recommendation.
Everything works just the same without a watch. You can also connect later under Settings → Watch & health data.
How much time do you have today? Trailscape builds you a calm loop from your location that ends back there.
To calculate it, the loop’s waypoints — including your starting point — are sent to the routing server.
Trailscape will ask for your location in a moment. To calculate it, the loop’s waypoints — including your starting point — are sent to the routing server.
